comparison.objective: Candidate separates finishing media from retained workpieces; PR captures a reference angle with a bevel gauge, transfers it, and draws a matching line.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate tests granular-flow control and bridge release; PR tests passive-hinge adjustment, angle retention during transport, tool seating, and guided marking.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires ≥98% media recovery without washer loss or spill and a released 3 s dwell; PR requires valid capture/carry plus line coverage, angle, gap, RMS, stray-mark, and nib-clearance thresholds.
comparison.reason: The tested abilities—aperture-based particle separation versus measurement transfer and guided marking—are unrelated beyond generic bimanual handling; both are numerically specified.
